Hero.badge: Leaders in Architectural Glass & Aluminum Solutions
Hero.description: PMS GLASS specializes in the fabrication and installation of structural glass facades, tempered safety glass, luxury shower enclosures, glass railings, office partitions, and custom mirrors engineered to international standards.

About.title: Crafting the Future Through Transparency & Strength
About.description: Since our establishment, PMS GLASS has been dedicated to pioneering thermal processing, tempered safety glass, and structural aluminum systems with an unwavering focus on safety, insulation, and aesthetic perfection.
About.missionText: Deliver integrated architectural glass solutions that exceed client expectations in durability, modern elegance, and pinpoint execution accuracy.
About.visionText: To stand as the premier and most trusted reference for high-end glass and aluminum solutions in the region.
About.cert1Desc: Engineered to withstand up to 5x higher mechanical pressure and thermal shock than ordinary glass.
About.cert2Desc: Double glazing technology combined with Low-E thermal radiation coatings.
About.cert3Desc: 100% rustproof, moisture-resistant hardware crafted for extreme longevity.
About.machineryDesc: Our state-of-the-art facility features automated tempering furnaces, edge polishers, and computer-controlled CNC cutting machines.
